", "tests/test_solution.py": "import math

import solution


def test_module_imports():
    assert solution is not None


def test_convert_example():
    assert solution.convert(1) == (1.0, 0.0)


def test_convert_zero():
    assert solution.convert(0) == (0.0, 0.0)
    assert solution.convert(0j) == (0.0, 0.0)


def test_convert_real_and_imaginary():
    assert solution.convert(-1) == (1.0, math.pi)
    assert solution.convert(1j) == (1.0, math.pi / 2)
    assert solution.convert(-1j) == (1.0, -math.pi / 2)


def test_convert_general_complex():
    r, theta = solution.convert(3 + 4j)
    assert math.isclose(r, 5.0)
    assert math.isclose(theta, 0.9272952180016122)
    r, theta = solution.convert(1 + 1j)
    assert math.isclose(r, math.sqrt(2))
    assert math.isclose(theta, math.pi / 4)
    r, theta = solution.convert(1 - 1j)
    assert math.isclose(r, math.sqrt(2))
    assert math.isclose(theta, -math.pi / 4)


def test_convert_returns_tuple_of_floats():
    result = solution.convert(2)
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
    assert len(result) == 2
    assert all(isinstance(value, float) for value in result)
